d:
After 10 years of work, I quit my job to pursue standup comedy full-time.
This is the story of how I swapped deadlines for punchlines, office politics for open mics, and a stable salary for… well, hope and a lot of stage time.
I’ve been doing stand-up for over 7 years, and now I’m giving it everything. From dealing with empty free time, balancing married life, and handling family reactions, to navigating the ups and downs of berozgar life—this set is full of real, funny moments.
"Berozgar" - Standup comedy by Rakesh Addlakha
